none: PAS CAM-078503: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N GRAT[...] ; R/ [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, 367-383. Mint is uncertain, 367-378, Reece Period 19. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N GRAT[...]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.30g, diameter is 18.55mm
